title: Winged Boots
description: You may ignore paths when choosing the next rooms to travel to [blue]3[/blue] times.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Counter-based relic that allows up to 3 instances of free travel (bypassing normal map adjacency). The counter decrements when you enter a room that is not directly connected to the previous room, indicating a non-standard path taken. Only available in single-player runs.
